task: Determine how many articles with the keyword 'autonomous vehicles' were published in the 'Electrical Engineering and Systems Science' section of ArXiv yesterday.
final_answer:
The advanced search has confirmed the result with this query:
`order: -announced_date_first; size: 50; date_range: from 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-25; classification: Electrical Engineering and Systems Science (eess); include_cross_list: True; terms: AND all="autonomous vehicles"`

This returns "Sorry, your query returned no results."

This matches what I found via the listing page (Thu, 24 Sep 2026 had 103 EESS entries, none of which contained "autonomous" anywhere in the visible text fields).

## Final Answer

**0 articles** with the keyword "autonomous vehicles" were published in the 'Electrical Engineering and Systems Science' section of ArXiv yesterday (Thursday, September 24, 2026).

I verified this answer through two independent methods:
1. **Direct listing page inspection**: I navigated to the EESS recent listings page and checked the 103 articles published on Thu, 24 Sep 2026. None of them contained the word "autonomous" anywhere in their title, subjects, or other visible fields.

2. **Advanced search verification**: I set up an ArXiv advanced search query with the term `"autonomous vehicles"` in all fields, limited to the Electrical Engineering and Systems Science (eess) classification, with a date range of 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-25 and cross-list papers included. The system returned "Sorry, your query returned no results."

To confirm the search system itself was functioning correctly, I also ran the same query without the date filter, which successfully returned 5,870 articles containing the phrase "autonomous vehicles" in EESS across all dates.
